Summary
Results-driven Solution Architect with 15+ years of experience in designing, building, and optimizing enterprise-scale data platforms across cloud and hybrid environments. Specialized in Snowflake architecture, Big Data ecosystems, and AI/ML integration. Expert in implementing robust ELT pipelines, Data Lakehouse architectures, and real-time streaming frameworks leveraging tools like AWS Data Migration Services, Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Snowflake, Redshift, Synapse, Kafka, and Python. Proven ability to architect cost- efficient, high-performance solutions that enhance data availability, quality, and analytics capabilities. Skilled in orchestrating CI/CD automation, data governance frameworks, and security controls aligned with enterprise compliance standards. raw_sections.skills:
Skills
Over 9 years of hands-on experience in designing and implementing cloud-based Big Data solutions with a strong emphasis on scalable architectures for Data Lakes, Data Migration, Data Warehousing, Data Visualization, and Data Engineering initiatives across Fortune 100 enterprises.
More than 5 years of experience in software development, specializing in web and enterprise applications using Java, PHP, and web services. Proficient in CMS platforms such as WordPress, Joomla, and Magnolia, along with analytics tools like Piwik and Google Analytics.
Extensive expertise applying AWS Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning tools—including ChatGPT, Perplexity, Amazon Lex, Amazon Translate, Amazon Polly, Amazon Rekognition, Amazon Comprehend, and Amazon Kendra—in mobile and enterprise applications for data analysis, predictive analytics, process automation, and chatbot development.
Advanced proficiency in Snowflake architecture, including data warehousing, data modeling, and schema design. Skilled at developing scalable and efficient data models to meet Proof of Concept (POC) objectives and validating performance under real- world conditions.
Strong background in Research and Development (R&D), Proof of Concept (POC) Development with a proven track record of exploring emerging technologies and integrating innovative solutions into enterprise systems. Adept at designing and executing Snowflake POCs to validate architectural strategies and demonstrate solution feasibility. Skilled in defining scope, objectives, and success criteria to ensure POCs effectively address business challenges and deliver measurable outcomes.
Strong experience in stakeholder communication and presenting POC outcomes to both technical and business audiences with clarity. Skilled in documenting findings, developing actionable recommendations, and facilitating discussions that enable informed decision-making.
Proven ability to lead projects and POC through planning, execution, and evaluation. Adept at coordinating cross-functional teams, managing timelines, and delivering outcomes aligned with strategic business goals.
Technologies
Mainstream Programming Languages: C, Java, Python, PHP, SQL, Scala, R
Web: HTML, CSS, Javascript & Ajax
Cloud: AWS, GCP & Azure
Computing: Cloud, Quantum
DataWarehouse: Oracle, IBM, Microsoft SQL, Redshift, Snowflake, Synapse, Google BigQuery
Database: AWS RDS, MySQL, Oracle, DB2, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, MongoDB, Document DB, Neptune
Business Intelligence/Data Visualizations: PowerBI, QuickSight, Sigma, D3JS, AM Charts, Tableau
ETL: Mulesoft, AWS Glue, Fivetran, Azure Data Factory, DBT, Matillion
Web Analytics: Piwik/Matomo, Google Analytics
Content Management System: WordPress, Joomla, Magnolia
Machine Learning: Comprehend, Code Guru, Kendra, Lex
IDEs: Eclipse, IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, Jupyter
Additional Technologies: Cognito, Glue DataBrew, Cloud Search, DMS, API Gateway, Lambda, MongoDB Charts, Managed Apache Airflow, SNS, Elastic Container Registry, Elastic Container Service, Github Actions Workflow, Neptune, IAM, VPC, EC2, CloudFormation, CloudWatch, Cloudera, PySpark, EMR, S3, Athena, Kinesis, Hadoop, HDFS, Hive, HBase, Impala, Sqoop, Cassandra, MapReduce, Zeppelin, Database Migration Service, Event Bridge, Step Functions, Application Discovery Service, Application Migration Service, Data Sync, Snowball, Transfer Family, Elastic Search, Spring, Struts, REST Web Services, JSP, Servlets, and more.
raw_sections.experience:
Experience
INTUCEO
Role: Solution Architect Duration: Aug 2025 - present
Description:
As a Solution Architect, I spearhead tenant onboarding for medical institutions onto healthcare client's Data platform, drive client calls, and evaluate the current Snowflake architecture to pinpoint improvement opportunities. I also define project scope, estimate required effort, and establish timelines, thereby laying out the groundwork for a robust Data Platform.
Responsibilities:
1. As an initial step, I conducted a thorough review of the Snowflake account. I implemented industry best practices and performed a comprehensive cleanup to optimize the environment, which resulted in the elimination of unnecessary storage and compute resources, thereby reducing operational costs.
2. I developed and compiled all missing project documentation, ensuring that every phase and component of the data platform was clearly documented. Additionally, I prepared detailed, end-to-end project architecture diagrams to provide stakeholders with a clear understanding of the system's structure and integration points.
3. To enhance monitoring and troubleshooting, I implemented a robust logging framework utilizing Snowflake's Event tables. This framework enables proactive identification and efficient resolution of production issues, strengthening system reliability and auditability.
4. I architected a comprehensive CI/CD process on Azure leveraging Jinja parameterized scripts, enabling standardized deployments across various environments. This approach supports seamless onboarding of multiple tenants and ensures consistency, traceability, and automation in the deployment workflow.
5. I designed and built data pipelines that facilitate both the initial setup of the Snowflake environment and the deployment of incremental changes. These pipelines are fully integrated with the CI/CD process, allowing for streamlined, repeatable, and scalable deployments.
6. I take an active role in pre-sales and project kickoff meetings with new clients, leading discussions to define project goals, clarify requirements, and establish clear communication channels.
Kipi.ai (A WNS Company)
Role: Snowflake Solution Architect Duration: Dec 2022 - Oct 2024
Description:
Responsible for the design, migration, and management of multiple enterprise applications on Snowflake. As a Solution Architect, I lead client onboarding during the Discovery phase, gathering business objectives, assessing existing architecture, identifying pain points and bottlenecks, and defining project scope, effort estimates, and timelines. This sets the foundation for transitioning into the Build phase for solution implementation followed by Support Phase.
Responsibilities:
1. Core stakeholder in the Architecture Review Board, guiding architectural decisions.
2. Spearhead the strategic vision and design the Future state/next gen architecture.
3. Define the scope and establish key milestones for the Thrive and Post-Thrive engagement phases.
4. Resource allocation driven by comprehensive project requirement analysis.
5. Partner with project managers to define and finalize the project execution plan for the build phase.
6. Oversee project team progress and ensure all deliverables are completed on schedule before transitioning to the support phase.
7. Foster and maintain strong client relationships to support long-term engagement and collaboration.
8. Develop and deliver Proofs of Concept (POCs) based on recommendations provided during the discovery phase.
9. Design and implement structured workflows and processes for the project team.
10. Provide mentorship and guidance to both project and reporting team members.
11. Conduct periodic health checks across all ongoing projects within the organization and proactively address any technical, project-related, or personnel challenges.
Industries/Domains:
Healthcare and Life Sciences
Financial Services
Manufacturing
Technology
Media and Entertainment
Retail and CPG
Telecom
Banking
Eligarf Technologies
Role: Head of Data Analytics & Cloud Computing Duration: Oct 2021 - Oct 2022
Description:
A product-based startup developing iMeUsWe, a secure and user-friendly mobile application available on both iOS and Android platforms. The app is designed specifically for Indian families to stay connected, explore their ancestry, and share meaningful stories across generations. Recognizing that every family holds unique and inspiring narratives, iMeUsWe aims to serve the globally dispersed Indian community by enabling them to reconnect with their roots, discover ancestral legacies, and digitally preserve their family's rich heritage for future generations.
Responsibilities:
1. Led cross-functional teams comprising Data Engineers, Data Scientists, Data Researchers, and the Mobile API development team.
2. Architected the ingestion framework and implemented an automated data pipeline for the mobile application to extract public data leveraging AWS services.
3. Instrumental in securing $10,000 in AWS credits for the product through participation in an accelerator program.
4. Instrumental in securing $10,000 in MongoDB credits for the product through participation in an accelerator program.
5. Formulating the product roadmap and forecasting AWS service expenditure to support scalability and deployment.
6. Conducted field visits to key spiritual sites including Ayodhya, Dwarka, Kashi, Gaya, and Haridwar to assess the governance, management, and storage practices of public data at these locations.
7. Implemented migration of existing workloads to automated data pipelines on AWS for ingesting data from various publicly available sources, including RCD, PM-Kisan, and others.
Affine.ai
Role: Principal Architect Duration: Feb 2021 - Oct 2021
Description:
Spearheaded multiple cross-functional initiatives, leveraging advanced analytics to inform strategic decision-making, while mentoring a team of analysts and consultants. Led data engineering engagements for Fortune 100 clients, including Cargill, DHL, and Microsoft.
Responsibilities:
1. Maintained strong working relationships with geographically dispersed teams in India, US, UK, and Singapore.
2. Business and P&L data aggregated from multiple sources is consolidated within the Cargill Data Platform's data lake.
3. The business objective is to minimize the cost overhead associated with voyage analysis by reconciling estimated and actual values, thereby streamlining the decision-making process.
4. Developed scalable data pipelines to ingest and transform high-priority business data for downstream analytics.
5. Engineered robust ETL workflows for acquiring and processing critical enterprise data.
6. Built and optimized data pipelines for the reliable ingestion and transformation of essential business datasets.
Sonata Software
Role: Big Data Consultant Duration: Jul 2012 - Jan 2021
Description:
Architecting Data Lake solutions, managing enterprise-scale Data Migrations, and delivering Data Engineering projects for Fortune 500 clients.
Responsibilities:
1. Served as a core contributor to the Data Engineering Practice team, developing multiple proof-of-concepts (POCs) leveraging Hadoop and various cloud technologies.
2. Contributed to the Customer Excellence Centre team by delivering demonstrations of cutting-edge emerging technologies to CIOs, CTOs, and CEOs during client engagements.
3. Architected and implemented Data Lakes across all three deployment models: On- Premises, Hybrid, and Cloud.
4. Engineered data migration pipelines from social media platforms and developed analytical modules including Customer 360 and Sentiment Analysis.
5. Provisioned and configured AWS Snowball, Database Migration Service (DMS), and other core AWS services to enable efficient data migration.
6. Designed and implemented connectors for Facebook and Twitter APIs to extract social media data for analytics and reporting purposes.
Mascon Global
Role: Senior Software Engineer/Developer Duration: Aug 2010 - Jul 2012
Description:
Engineering and Development of Kioskiapp and web platforms enabling voucher distribution and online top-ups leveraging payment gateway APIs with payment gateway integration.
KioskiApp facilitates mobile top-up services via kiosk machines. This project involves the development of a front-end interface. The functionalities provided by KioskiApp include Top- up Sale, Voucher Sale, Top-up Cancellation, and Voucher Cancellation.
WebTopupApp provides mobile top-up services through a web-based application. This project also includes front-end interface development. WebTopupApp supports Top-up Sale and online payment for recharges.
Responsibilities:
1. Played a key role in the team, contributing to the end-to-end development of Kiosk and Web applications.
2. Actively contributed to the full software development lifecycle of Kiosk and Web applications.
3. Led and supported the full-stack development of Kiosk and Web applications, playing a critical role across all phases of the lifecycle.
4. Implemented seamless payment gateway integration for web applications using web services (e.g., REST APIs, SOAP, specific payment providers).
5. Implemented user interface components leveraging web development frameworks and technologies.
6. Engineered front-end solutions with a focus on performance and usability, using web development tools and frameworks.
Savinirs Infotech Pvt Ltd
Role: Junior Engineer/Developer Duration: Oct 2009 - Aug 2010
Description:
Designing and developing web-based solutions including e-commerce platforms and content management systems (CMS). Engineering scalable web applications, including e-commerce systems and content management platforms.
Responsibilities:
1. Independently re-architected and redeveloped the company-owned website along with a dynamic admin module for real-time management of job openings, user feedback, and website content.
2. Contributed to the development of a prototype for an e-commerce application, including the deployment of blogs and dynamic web content.
